headline: Iran: US lack of mediation, is main obstacle to diplomacy

DXY.source: contemporaneous market reports; exact intraday level from latest verified snapshot

immediate.rationale: A new obstacle to Iran diplomacy modestly raises geopolitical safe-haven demand.

next_session.rationale: If diplomacy remains stalled, the geopolitical risk premium can persist.

predictions.mechanism: Reduced odds of near-term diplomatic progress support geopolitical risk premia.
predictions.invalidation: Concrete mediation progress, renewed talks or a sharp reversal lower in oil and geopolitical risk.

immediate.rationale: Reduced diplomacy prospects are mildly risk-off while oil remains above $100.

next_session.rationale: Persistent conflict and expensive oil can continue to pressure broad equities.

predictions.mechanism: Diplomatic setbacks can keep oil and inflation risk elevated and weigh on risk sentiment.
predictions.invalidation: A credible diplomatic breakthrough or sharp oil/yield reversal.

immediate.rationale: Risk-off sentiment plus high oil and near-5% long yields remain adverse for duration-sensitive technology shares.

next_session.rationale: Persistent geopolitical and rates pressure can remain a headwind for growth equities.

predictions.mechanism: Oil-driven inflation pressure reinforces elevated yields and risk aversion.
predictions.invalidation: A diplomatic breakthrough or a strong reversal lower in yields and oil.
